rfeExplain.text: What this letter is and who sent itThis is a Request for Evidence (RFE) sent by the U.S. Citizenship and Immigration Services (USCIS) Potomac Service Center regarding Form I-765 for NAME 1 (Receipt Number: RECEIPT 1).Why you probably received itUSCIS is reviewing your application for post-completion Optional Practical Training (OPT) and has determined that the current evidence is not sufficient to establish your eligibility.What it asks forYou must submit the following items together with this notice to the address listed:A copy of your Form I-20 endorsed by your Designated School Official within the last 30 days, showing the OPT recommendation.A copy of your passport biographic page.Two passport-style photographs with your name and A NUMBER 1 written lightly on the back.A copy of your marriage certificate for your F-2 dependent spouse, NAME 2.The deadlineYour response must be received by December 16, 2026.What happens if you do nothingIf USCIS does not receive the requested evidence by that date, they will decide your application based on the existing record, and it may be denied.Please check anything about your immigration status with your school's international student office or a qualified immigration attorney.

rfeFollowUp.text: The letter does not state whether the two passport-style photographs can be uploaded online or if they must be mailed.It instructs you to send this notice with your response to the address above, but does not provide specific instructions on the submission method for the physical items. Please check your USCIS online account or contact the USCIS Contact Center at PHONE 1 to confirm how to submit the photographs.
rfeFollowUp.questionSent: Does NAME 1 have to mail the two passport photos, or can they be uploaded?

rentChecklistEs.text: La fecha límite para pagar o contactar a la oficina es el November 24, 2026.Revisar el estado de cuenta con la referencia de ledger ACCOUNT 2 para verificar el alquiler de $1,450.00 y el cargo por pago tardío de $75.00.Preparar el pago total de $1,525.00 mediante el portal de residentes, un giro postal (money order) en la oficina, o un cheque a nombre de Maple Court Apartments.Comunicarse a la oficina al PHONE 1 antes del límite si tiene problemas para pagar y desea discutir un plan de pago.Actualizar a la administración si sus datos de contacto cambiaron de PHONE 2 o EMAIL 1.Antes de enviar:Verifique que el pago total de $1,525.00 llegue antes del November 24, 2026.Asegúrese de incluir su Tenant ID ACCOUNT 1 en el cheque si paga por ese medio.

bursarDraft.text: Subject: Registration Hold - Student Health Insurance - NAME 1 - Student ID: ACCOUNT 1Dear Office of Student Accounts,Thank you for your letter dated November 18, 2026, regarding the health insurance charge and registration hold on my account (Student ID: ACCOUNT 1, SEVIS ID: SEVIS 1).I am writing to let you know that I am submitting the online waiver form by December 1, 2026. For your reference, my current insurer lists me under Member ID: ACCOUNT 2. Please find attached [describe the document you are attaching] to support my waiver request.Could you please confirm whether my registration hold will be removed automatically once this waiver form is reviewed and approved?Thank you for your assistance.Sincerely,NAME 1Note to the reader: Please check anything about your immigration status with your school's international student office or a qualified immigration attorney.

offlineOnDevice.text: This is an official letter from Example State University's student accounts office regarding a charge for your student health insurance.You have two choices:Waiver: If you already have health insurance, you must submit an online waiver form with your policy details by December 1, 2026.Keep Plan: You can pay the $1,286.00 charge or enroll in a payment plan by December 9, 2026.If you do nothing, you will not be able to register for spring classes.If you have questions about your immigration status or this matter, please contact the school's international student office or a qualified attorney.
